text_en: The Ancient , to the dearly beloved Gaius, whom I love in truth .
text_la: Senior Gajo carissimo, quem ego diligo in veritate.
text_pt: O presbítero ao amado Gaio, a quem em verdade eu amo.
text_el: Ὁ πρεσβύτερος Γαΐῳ τῷ ἀγαπητῷ, ὃν ἐγὼ ἀγαπῶ ἐν ἀληθείᾳ.

text_en: Dearly beloved, concerning all things I make it my prayer that you may proceed prosperously and fare well, as your soul does prosperously.
text_la: Carissime, de omnibus orationem facio prospere te ingredi, et valere sicut prospere agit anima tua.
text_pt: Amado, desejo que te vá bem em todas as coisas, e que tenhas saúde, assim como bem vai a tua alma.
text_el: ἀγαπητέ, περὶ πάντων εὔχομαί σε εὐοδοῦσθαι καὶ ὑγιαίνειν, καθὼς εὐοδοῦταί σου ἡ ψυχή.

text_en: I was exceedingly glad when the brethren came and gave testimony to the truth in you, even as you walk in the truth .
text_la: Gavisus sum valde venientibus fratribus, et testimonium perhibentibus veritati tuæ, sicut tu in veritate ambulas.
text_pt: Porque muito me alegrei quando os irmãos vieram, e testificaram da tua verdade, como tu andas na verdade.
text_el: ἐχάρην [γὰρ] λίαν ἐρχομένων ἀδελφῶν καὶ μαρτυρούντων σου τῇ ἀληθείᾳ, καθὼς σὺ ἐν ἀληθείᾳ περιπατεῖς.

text_en: I have no greater grace than this, to hear that my children walk in truth .
text_la: Majorem horum non habeo gratiam, quam ut audiam filios meos in veritate ambulare.
text_pt: Não tenho maior gozo do que este, o de ouvir que os meus filhos andam na verdade.
text_el: μειζοτέραν τούτων οὐκ ἔχω χάριν, ἵνα ἀκούω τὰ ἐμὰ τέκνα ἐν τῇ ἀληθείᾳ περιπατοῦντα.

text_en: Dearly beloved, you do faithfully whatever you do for the brethren: and that for strangers,
text_la: Carissime, fideliter facis quidquid operaris in fratres, et hoc in peregrinos,
text_pt: Amado, procedes fielmente em tudo o que fazes para com os irmãos, e para com os estranhos,
text_el: ἀγαπητέ, πιστὸν ποιεῖς ὃ ἐὰν ἐργάσῃ εἰς τοὺς ἀδελφοὺς καὶ τοῦτο ξένους,

text_en: who have given testimony to your charity in the sight of the church . Whom you shall do well to bring forward on their way in a manner worthy of God :
text_la: qui testimonium reddiderunt caritati tuæ in conspectu ecclesiæ : quos, benefaciens, deduces digne Deo.
text_pt: Que em presença da igreja testificaram do teu amor; aos quais, se conduzires como é digno para com Deus, bem farás;
text_el: οἳ ἐμαρτύρησάν σου τῇ ἀγάπῃ ἐνώπιον ἐκκλησίας, οὓς καλῶς ποιήσεις προπέμψας ἀξίως τοῦ θεοῦ:

text_en: Because, for his name they went out, taking nothing of the Gentiles .
text_la: Pro nomine enim ejus profecti sunt, nihil accipientes a gentibus.
text_pt: Porque pelo seu Nome saíram, nada tomando dos gentios.
text_el: ὑπὲρ γὰρ τοῦ ὀνόματος ἐξῆλθον μηδὲν λαμβάνοντες ἀπὸ τῶν ἐθνικῶν.

text_en: We therefore ought to receive such: that we may be fellow helpers of the truth .
text_la: Nos ergo debemus suscipere hujusmodi, ut cooperatores simus veritatis.
text_pt: Portanto, aos tais devemos receber, para que sejamos cooperadores da verdade.
text_el: ἡμεῖς οὖν ὀφείλομεν ὑπολαμβάνειν τοὺς τοιούτους, ἵνα συνεργοὶ γινώμεθα τῇ ἀληθείᾳ.

text_en: I had written perhaps to the church : but Diotrephes, who loves to have the preeminence among them, does not receive us.
text_la: Scripsissem forsitan ecclesiæ : sed is qui amat primatum gerere in eis, Diotrephes, non recipit nos:
text_pt: Tenho escrito à igreja; mas Diótrefes, que procura ter entre eles o primado, não nos recebe.
text_el: ἔγραψά τι τῇ ἐκκλησίᾳ: ἀλλ' ὁ φιλοπρωτεύων αὐτῶν Διοτρέφης οὐκ ἐπιδέχεται ἡμᾶς.

text_en: For this cause, if I come, I will advertise his works which he does, with malicious words prating against us. And as if these things were not enough for him, neither does he himself receive the brethren, and them that do receive them he forbids, and casts out of the church .
text_la: propter hoc si venero, commonebo ejus opera, quæ facit, verbis malignis garriens in nos : et quasi non ei ista sufficiant, neque ipse suscipit fratres : et eos qui suscipiunt, prohibet, et de ecclesia ejicit.
text_pt: Por isso, se eu for, trarei à memória as obras que ele faz, proferindo contra nós palavras maliciosas; e, não contente com isto, não recebe os irmãos, e impede os que querem recebê-los, e os lança fora da igreja.
text_el: διὰ τοῦτο, ἐὰν ἔλθω, ὑπομνήσω αὐτοῦ τὰ ἔργα ἃ ποιεῖ, λόγοις πονηροῖς φλυαρῶν ἡμᾶς: καὶ μὴ ἀρκούμενος ἐπὶ τούτοις οὔτε αὐτὸς ἐπιδέχεται τοὺς ἀδελφοὺς καὶ τοὺς βουλομένους κωλύει καὶ ἐκ τῆς ἐκκλησίας ἐκβάλλει.

text_en: Dearly beloved, follow not that which is evil : but that which is good . He that does good is of God : he that does evil has not seen God .
text_la: Carissime, noli imitari malum, sed quod bonum est. Qui benefacit, ex Deo est : qui malefacit, non vidit Deum.
text_pt: Amado, não sigas o mal, mas o bem. Quem faz o bem é de Deus; mas quem faz o mal não tem visto a Deus.
text_el: ἀγαπητέ, μὴ μιμοῦ τὸ κακὸν ἀλλὰ τὸ ἀγαθόν. ὁ ἀγαθοποιῶν ἐκ τοῦ θεοῦ ἐστιν: ὁ κακοποιῶν οὐχ ἑώρακεν τὸν θεόν.

text_en: To Demetrius, testimony is given by all, and by the truth itself: yea and we also give testimony. And you know that our testimony is true .
text_la: Demetrio testimonium redditur ab omnibus, et ab ipsa veritate, sed et nos testimonium perhibemus : et nosti quoniam testimonium nostrum verum est.
text_pt: Todos dão testemunho de Demétrio, até a mesma verdade; e também nós testemunhamos; e vós bem sabeis que o nosso testemunho é verdadeiro.
text_el: Δημητρίῳ μεμαρτύρηται ὑπὸ πάντων καὶ ὑπὸ αὐτῆς τῆς ἀληθείας: καὶ ἡμεῖς δὲ μαρτυροῦμεν, καὶ οἶδας ὅτι ἡ μαρτυρία ἡμῶν ἀληθής ἐστιν.

text_en: I had many things to write unto you: but I would not by ink and pen write to you.
text_la: Multa habui tibi scribere : sed nolui per atramentum et calamum scribere tibi.
text_pt: Tinha muito que escrever, mas não quero escrever-te com tinta e pena.
text_el: Πολλὰ εἶχον γράψαι σοι, ἀλλ' οὐ θέλω διὰ μέλανος καὶ καλάμου σοι γράφειν:

text_en: But I hope speedily to see you: and we will speak mouth to mouth.
text_la: Spero autem protinus te videre, et os ad os loquemur.
text_pt: Espero, porém, ver-te brevemente, e falaremos face a face.
text_el: ἐλπίζω δὲ εὐθέως σε ἰδεῖν, καὶ στόμα πρὸς στόμα λαλήσομεν.

text_en: Peace be to you. Our friends salute you. Salute the friends by name .
text_la: Pax tibi. Salutant te amici. Saluta amicos nominatim.
text_el: εἰρήνη σοι. ἀσπάζονταί σε οἱ φίλοι. ἀσπάζου τοὺς φίλους κατ' ὄνομα.
